scope: Documentation Site Navigation & Slide Selection Fix: Restore Standard Slide Scrolling and Thumbnail Click Switching on Overview and Installation Sections Without Altering API Reference

tasks.title: Decouple API Reference Function Scoping & Fix Slide State Lock on Overview and Installation
tasks.description: Diagnose and fix why the Overview (/docs) and Installation (/docs/installation) sections remain pinned to Slide 1 and refuse to switch slides on scroll or click. Root cause: The hierarchical function-stepping logic (`activeFunctionIndex === 0` lockout checks or conditional route guards in `PowerPointSlideDeck.jsx`) is leaking into non-API sections where slides have no sub-functions, causing the slide state to continually evaluate as bounded at index 0 and reset or ignore slide updates. Add explicit section detection (`const isApiReference = pathname.includes('/docs/api-reference')`) so function-level stepping is executed strictly when `isApiReference === true`, and standard direct slide-stepping runs on Overview and Installation.

tasks.title: Restore Direct Slide Selection via Thumbnail Clicks on Overview and Installation
tasks.description: Fix the thumbnail click handler (`onSelectSlide` / `setCurrentSlideIndex`) in `SlideThumbnailSidebar.jsx` and `PowerPointSlideDeck.jsx` for the Overview and Installation pages. Ensure that clicking any slide thumbnail directly updates the active slide index (`currentSlideIndex = clickedIndex`), triggers the slide transition cleanly, updates the thumbnail highlight outline (`2px solid #D24726`), and immediately mounts the corresponding slide card without being intercepted or clamped back to index 0.

tasks.title: Restore Native Slide-to-Slide Wheel & Touch Transitions on Overview and Installation
tasks.description: Ensure mouse wheel and touch gestures on Overview and Installation sections advance and reverse slide decks directly: (1) If internal card content is scrollable, allow normal scrolling until hitting top/bottom boundaries, (2) Once at the bottom boundary (`scrollTop + clientHeight >= scrollHeight - 2`), scrolling downward advances directly to `currentSlideIndex + 1` (up to `totalSlides - 1`), (3) Once at the top boundary (`scrollTop <= 0`), scrolling upward reverts directly to `currentSlideIndex - 1` (down to `0`), and (4) Verify API Reference continues to execute hierarchical function-stepping independently.
